dimensions.assessment: Provides funding for research, development, and a study to improve teaching practices, which is an administrative and programmatic improvement rather than a life-changing mandate.
dimensions.evidence: research and development to support high-quality mathematical modeling education

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $10 million annually for NSF awards and $1 million annually for NASEM reports from fiscal years 2026 through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: $10,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2026 through 2030 is authorized to be used

dimensions.assessment: Requires specific NSF grant-making authority and a required agreement with the National Academies, expiring in 2029.
dimensions.evidence: requires the National Science Foundation (NSF) to take certain actions to increase mathematical and statistical modeling education

dimensions.assessment: Authorizations and award authorities span a limited timeframe ending on September 30, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: This authority to provide awards expires on September 30, 2029.

card.summary: The Mathematical and Statistical Modeling Education Act directs the National Science Foundation to coordinate research and development efforts aimed at modernizing mathematics and statistics in pre-kindergarten through 12th-grade education. It focuses on incorporating mathematical and statistical modeling, data science, computational thinking, and project-based learning into schools through competitive awards, partnerships, and an independent study by the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine.
